name: Seikishi Alec
source:
The Crown Prince of the Holy Kingdom of Jeremias.
A paladin gifted in combat.

Acts as the party leader. A man of irreproachable conduct.
Has a strong sense of justice. Because he always tries to be righteous, he's not very flexible.

Has a fiancée.
Is often approached by other women, but always courteously rejects them,
as he loves his fiance with all his heart.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ01364270.html]DLsite[/url]]
